note: Oak savanna, glades and grassland along Brush Creek west of Collins, with three primitive camping spots, each beside a small gravel lot on the road through the area: this one off Route J at the south lot, the others at the road bend ~750 m north and at the north lot ~1.1 km northwest. No facilities; spot length is not published. --Claude
summary: Confirmed: MDC 'Designated Camping Sites', free, FCFS, no hookups, 14-day limit. Three single spots ~0.75-1.1 km apart, each by a gravel lot on the same road - no split. Pin is in the grass ~60 m from the south lot (fine; lot coords given). Not waterfront confirmed. Phone matches.
flags: INCLUSION/FIT: Things to Do lists 'Designated Camping Sites' (and 'Open Camping - Walk-in/Float-in/Backpack'); the 6/23/2025 map shows a Primitive Camping symbol beside each of its three parking lots. GIS 27: 469 (stored pin) 37.87009,-93.70951; 470 at 37.87627,-93.71314; 468 at 37.87795,-93.71777. Lots (layer 26, all gravel): 408 at 37.86965,-93.70904 (off Route J, ~25x30 m on imagery), 407 at 37.87683,-93.71274, 406 at 37.87834,-93.71862. Access is on Route J / the county road - no ford. Spot length unpublished (caveat in note).
PIN: stored 37.87009,-93.70951 (GIS 469) is in open grass ~60 m NW of gravel lot 408 - within tolerance; if a drivable spot is preferred, 37.86965,-93.70904 is the lot.
SPLIT: none - three single spots 0.75-1.1 km apart on the same road; one per spot is out.
WATERFRONT: not waterfront confirmed - Brush Creek is ~150-200 m west of the pin through woods (and ~100 m from spot 470 through woods).
PHONE: (417) 853-4592 on the area page matches.
